findings.statement: 48 MapInfos organize Ekios/Gildrat, sewer and Kravens/Melios mines, interiors, finale and test/release areas. There are 50 map files: Map023 is missing while 058-060 lack MapInfo entries.
149 direct code201 transfers were mapped; 8 target missing/out-of-bounds destinations. Start Map057 (20,7) has no direct code201 incoming or outgoing edge; reachability remains Playtest-pending.
Quest hubs and mines use variable/page gates; encounterList is populated only on Maps034/047/057 with encounterStep 999, while scripted battles concentrate in Maps038/041/053/055/057.

Sewer 24→25→26 and Kravens 30/33/47/48/28 form multi-map dungeon structures; finale chains 36→37→38→41 and 21→55→53 coexist. Map035 is 100x90 with 95 events and 70 autorun pages, a static pacing/softlock-risk surface.

Named POIs include quest NPCs in Maps007/008/011/017/052, valves/levers/ore/hidden area in mines, and 19 quest markers in Map036. Active EventsMoveCore/MapCameraZoom commands mean final flow and presentation require Playtest.
